title: fix(service-package,cloud-connection): convert stored package bodies forward at the sys_packages and marketplace doors
body:
Fixes #23974
Clause-②: yes (widening)

Three package doors called the registry without going through the ADR-0087 versioned window that PR #23962 opened at the registration door. This PR routes each door through that window, or records why the door stays strict. The conversion entry point `ObjectQL.convertPackageBodyForward` is reused as it stands. Nothing changes in `packages/objectql/**`, `packages/metadata-core/**` or `packages/spec/**`, and `SchemaRegistry.installPackage` gets no second judge.

## Premise check, on `origin/main` (base `92fd343`, merged up to `fd9664ffa`)

- **Door 1 holds.** `service-package/src/index.ts:715` called `registry.installPackage(rec.manifest)`, and one `try/catch` wrapped the whole loop. That catch logged anything other than a seam failure at **`debug`**. So the first record the registry refused also dropped every record after it, and nothing above `debug` said so.
- **Door 2 holds** (`protocol.ts:31393`). Its premise as a conversion door does not, see door 2 below.
- **Door 3 holds, on both paths.** Rehydrate (`:780`/`:790`/`:795`/`:827`) and the install path (`:1554`/`:1618`/`:1625`) both hand `register` the raw body and hand the same raw body to `bindArtifactHandlers` / `applySideEffects`.
- **Correction to the card's reach.** HotCRM 4.0.1 exactly as published declares `engines.protocol: ^17.7.0`. This runtime is protocol 18, so the ADR-0087 **D1 handshake** at doors 1 and 3 (and `assertProtocolCompat` at door 2) refuses that body by name **before** the registry or any conversion sees it. Door 1 `continue`s past it, so a HotCRM-4.0.1 row alone does not stop hydration on v18 (pinned below). The window at these doors opens for a stored body whose range **admits** major 18 and whose floor predates a retirement, for example `>=17.7.0`. The converting pins restamp the fixture's body that way: same 17.7.0 floor, same pages. The loop defect is real for any registry refusal and is fixed below.

## Door 1: `sys_packages` boot hydration (`@objectstack/service-package`)

- Each stored body goes through `objectql.convertPackageBodyForward` (reached through the engine the plugin already holds, as `registry` is) before `registry.installPackage` judges it. The stored row is not rewritten, so it converts again at every boot. This follows the ADR-0087 addendum: metadata at rest replays the chain at every load.
- The loop survives one bad record. A record the registry still refuses after conversion is logged at **`error`**, naming the package id, carrying the refusal's message, and with the refusal attached. The line also states the consequence (absent from the registry for this process while its row remains) and the fix. The records after it keep hydrating.
- The `isSeamUnreadable` WARN is untouched.
- `Hydrated N package(s) from sys_packages into registry` now counts exactly the records the registry **accepted** in that pass. It excludes records the D1 handshake refused, records already registered, and records the registry refused (each of those is reported by name).

## Door 2: `protocol.installPackage` / `POST /api/v1/packages` stays STRICT (authoring-side)

The decision comes from what each caller actually sends. It is recorded at the call site in `protocol.ts`, and the code is unchanged.

- **`POST /api/v1/packages`** (`packages/runtime/src/domains/packages.ts`) parses the whole body through `PackageInstallBodySchema` / the closed `ManifestSchema` before calling the primitive. Measured on this tree: the HotCRM body is refused there with `Unrecognized key(s) on this package manifest: pages` in all three cases: as published, with only the convertible shapes, and with the conversion applied by hand. No package body that carries metadata collections reaches the primitive over HTTP, so a conversion inside it would never run for this door.
- **`duplicatePackage`** (`:27496`) copies `srcPkg.manifest`, the registry's own record. The registry holds only what it accepted (already converted at whichever door installed it), so the duplicate sees the converted body. It behaves the same either way.
- **The unmanaged install's base** (`:27870`): `plan.baseManifest` is identity keys plus `id` / `name` / `namespace` (`package-unmanaged-install.ts:473`), with no collections. The window has nothing to act on.
- **AI Studio's blueprint tools** (triage's cloud reading, `6219354007`) call the primitive in-process with a manifest they are authoring now. A retired declaration there is the author's to fix, refused loudly at the moment of writing.
- **What `sys_packages` stores:** unchanged. The primitive refuses before it persists, so a refused body writes no row. A body that lands in `sys_packages` by any road is data at rest from then on, and door 1 converts it at every boot.
- Pinned over the real registry: the same converting body through `protocol.installPackage` is refused with `MisplacedDefaultPageError` (`INVALID_METADATA`, 422), with no registry record, no `sys_packages` row and no conversion warning.

## Door 3: the marketplace install's side readers (`@objectstack/cloud-connection`)

- Install and rehydrate each convert the body **once** (a new `convertPackageBodyForward(ctx, manifest)` that delegates to the engine's entry point). That one object is what `manifest.register`, `bindArtifactHandlers`, `applySideEffects` and the rehydrate's seed read (`maybeHealSampleData`, which now takes the converted body) receive. The ledger keeps the body as installed.
- `register` meets the entry point a second time. The already-converted body comes back with no second warning, and the pin asserts exactly one warning per conversion on both paths.

## Pins (real `SchemaRegistry` throughout; a stub cannot refuse)

- `service-package/src/hydration-convert-forward.test.ts`: **real stack** (`ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` + `SqlDriver` better-sqlite3 on disk + `PackageServicePlugin`). One process publishes through the `package` service; a second process on the same file hydrates, as a restart does. I chose the real stack because the defect sits between the store, the engine's converter and the registry's refusal, and a unit double can show none of the three. Cases:
  - the body hydrates converted with the named warning, and the row stays as published;
  - a refused record (named at `error`, with `code`/`status` asserted on the attached refusal) followed by a record that still hydrates;
  - CONTROL: a range-less body is refused exactly as before, with no conversion;
  - HotCRM 4.0.1 as published is refused by the D1 handshake and the next record hydrates;
  - door 2's strict refusal.
- `cloud-connection/src/marketplace-install-local-convert-forward.test.ts`: a real `ObjectKernel` + `ObjectQLPlugin` supplies the converter and the `manifest` service. On rehydrate and install, all readers receive the **same** converted object. CONTROL on both paths: a range-less body is refused at `register` (install: `422 PLUGIN_REGISTER_FAILED`; rehydrate: the refusal is logged for that entry with `code`/`status`), and no side reader runs.

### Ablations (`scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`; each restore proven blob == HEAD and `git diff HEAD` empty)

| # | mutation | result |
|---|---|---|
| A1 | door 1 hands `rec.manifest` unconverted | 2 red (`hydrates … converted`, `keeps hydrating`) |
| A2 | door 1's per-record catch rethrows | 2 red (`keeps hydrating`, CONTROL: the refusal falls to the old `debug` line) |
| A3 | rehydrate binder reads `entry.manifest` | 1 red (`rehydrate — … same converted body`) |
| A4 | install `applySideEffects` reads the raw `manifest` | 1 red (`install — … same converted body`) |

The tests import the touched files from `src/` (and `@objectstack/objectql` / `core` / `driver-sql` / `metadata-protocol` through anchored vitest aliases to `src/`), so no `dist/` leg applies.

## Verification, on head `fe7b944bb`

- `@objectstack/service-package`: test 118/118 (8 files), typecheck exit 0. `@objectstack/cloud-connection`: test 559/559 (47 files), typecheck exit 0. `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (a comment-only change): typecheck exit 0, plus `durable-package.test.ts` 10/10. Its full suite is left to CI, a declared narrowing. `--listFiles` confirms that both new test files are in their package's tsc program.
- `pnpm lint` (full, `eslint . --no-inline-config`): exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands`: 98 derived, 97 run with exit 0. One is NOT MEASURED: `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 (`PREREQUISITE NOT MET`, it needs every package's `dist/`), and CI runs it. `check-plugin-teardown-shape.mjs --self-test` first exited 3 on the shallow clone; after fetching its pinned fixture commit it exited 0. `--ran` reconciliation: 98 accounted, 97 run, 1 NOT-MEASURED derived from the recorded exit 3.

## Wiring the pins needed

- `service-package` devDependencies `@objectstack/objectql`, `@objectstack/driver-sql`, `@objectstack/metadata-protocol` (no cycle; `pnpm-lock.yaml` +9). Its `vitest.config.ts` gains anchored aliases to those packages' `src/` (`check:test-source-alias` green, no ledger widening).
- Both new tests read the one HotCRM fixture under `packages/objectql/src/__fixtures__/`, so it is declared in `scripts/cross-package-test-inputs.mjs` and `turbo.json` (`check:cross-package-test-inputs`, `check:ci-filter-parity` green; `core` already covers the path).

## Acceptance notes

- **Other raw-ledger readers in `marketplace-install-local-plugin.ts`, outside the claimed region:** the reseed door (`applySideEffects(ctx, entry.manifest, … door: 'reseed')`), the sample-data probes that read `seedDatasetsOf(entry.manifest)`, and the install-time `unrunnableCode(ctx, manifest, …)` gate. These belong to the same family as door 3. No ADR-0087 conversion today rewrites `data`, `translations`, `jobs` or `hooks`, so none of them gives a wrong answer now. Carrier: none.
- **`duplicatePackage`'s `catch {}`** around its `installPackage` call swallows a refusal (pre-existing, unchanged here). Carrier: none.
- **`checkProtocolCompat` reads `^17.7.0 || ^18.0.0` as `incompatible`** on this runtime (measured with a direct call), although the range admits major 18 and the handshake's own comment says an unparsed range never causes a false rejection. Reach through a public door is not measured. Reported to the seat.
- The runtime's no-protocol fallback in `POST /api/v1/packages` (`registry.installPackage` after `assertProtocolCompat`) is the same authoring door as door 2 and stays strict too.
